items.item_text: Bachelors Other in healthcare related field or equivalent professional experience
Minimum of five (5) years’ related experience in an acute or ambulatory healthcare setting
Project Management and/or Project Team Leader experience, prior experience training and educating others and
Experience in electronic medical record applications

Education of physicians and clinical staff. Effectively serves as resource to providers, AHP's, extenders, physician office staff and staff re: use of clinical information system tools (Cerner, consult accelerator, etc.). Develops educational tools for physicians and other clinicians.
Comfortable with 1 on 1 training or managing small groups on multiple computers if training in group setting.
Coordinates physician and other clinician service requests and incident resolutions through the Dignity Health IT Help Desk and Dignity Health change request process.
Demonstrates understands physician needs and practice patterns and workflow in hospitals.

Collaborates with Clinical Informatics Director, Project Managers, Clinical Informatics and stake holders to optimize current clinical information system to meet the needs of the physicians. Serves in liaison role for all new physician-related applications.
Participates in cross divisional projects as needed and performs other duties as assigned.
